issues.claim: "no client portal, upload, e-signature or payment link is published on the site; documents go by email or fax" (Section 3, "What's happening now")
issues.problem: The first half is confirmed directly in the page HTML (no form, portal, upload, e-sign or payment link on the home, contact, consultation, about, testimonials, divorce and child_support pages). The second half - "documents go by email or fax" - is not stated anywhere on the site or in any cited source; it is an inference drawn from email and fax being the only published channels. Presenting it as fact implies knowledge of her internal document workflow that the public record does not support, and would read as insider knowledge to the recipient.
issues.fix: Keep the verified facts and mark the second half as the inference it is, e.g. "no portal, upload, e-sign or payment link is published; email and fax are the only channels the site publishes (our inference - we can confirm this with you)", or move it into the "Worth checking together" line as a question.

issues.claim: "enquiries come by phone (Monday-Friday 9-5) or email" (Section 2) and "the contact page has no enquiry form or tap-to-call link" (Section 1)
issues.problem: Accurate, but the 9-5 hours are not on the website at all - they come from the Google Business Profile (Mon-Fri 9 AM-5 PM, Sat/Sun closed, confirmed). The audit body states the hours as a property of the practice without pointing at that listing, while the site itself publishes no office hours.
issues.fix: Attribute the hours in-line, e.g. "phone (hours listed on Google: Monday-Friday 9-5) or email", so a reader re-checking the site does not find them missing.
